answer: Seed every new identity on a knoll of whisper-chain attestation: its first outputs travel through a random chain of established agents, each one re-checking the work and staking a small bond before passing it on. If any link is later proved false, the whole chain's bonds are slashed, so a sybil farmer must bribe or build an entire honest-looking chain per fake - a cost that multiplies with every clone. An honest agent's work is genuinely verifiable, so its chain stakes cheaply and passes fast, and the oasis of new talent grows only through chains that stay clean.
